name: QuerySimilarImageClusters

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token.

If the total number of clusters is greater than the value of MaxResults, you must specify this parameter. The next call to the operation returns results lexicographically after the NextToken parameter value.

The first time you call this operation in a query, set this parameter to null
parameters.help_zh:
翻页标记。

当文件总数大于设置的MaxResults时，用于翻页的Token。从NextToken开始按字典序返回文件信息列表。

在一次查询中首次调用此接口时，将此值设置为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Value range: 0 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回聚类列表中最大任务数量。取值范围为（0，100 ]，默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The custom tags, which are used to filter tasks
parameters.help_zh: 自定义标签，用于根据标签过滤任务
parameters.name: custom_labels

parameters.help_en:
The sorting field.

CreateTime: the time when the clusters were created.
UpdateTime: the time when the clusters were updated. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，可选值如下：

CreateTime：分类的创建时间。

UpdateTime：分类的更新时间（默认）
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.
desc: descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值范围如下：

asc：升序。
desc：降序（默认）
parameters.name: order

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. If the total number of clusters is greater than the value of MaxResults, this token can be used to retrieve the next page. This parameter has a value only if not all the clusters that meet the condition are returned.

Pass this value as the value of NextToken in the next query to return the subsequent clusters
NextToken.description_zh:
翻页标记。当聚类列表总数大于设置的MaxResults时，用于翻页的Token。符合条件的聚类列表未全部返回时，此参数才有值。

下一次查询聚类时将此值作为NextToken传入，将后续的聚类列表返回
